name: wait_for
description: Waits locally inside the engine until a UI condition (text_exists, window_exists, window_active, element_exists) is satisfied or timeout expires, eliminating slow LLM polling loops.

target.description: Optional window title substring to scope the search.

query.description: Text or element query to spot.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait before timing out.

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds between checks.
